import sys
import math

eps = 1e-100
diff = float('inf')

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    x, y, n = map(int, input_data)
    xbyy = x / y

    ans = (0, 1)

    for b in range(1, n + 1):
        ald = xbyy * b
        a1 = int(math.floor(ald))
        a2 = a1 + 1

        diff1 = abs(xbyy - (a1 / b))
        diff2 = abs((a2 / b) - xbyy)

        if diff > diff1 + 1e-15:
            ans = (a1, b)
            diff = diff1

        if diff > diff2 + 1e-15:
            ans = (a2, b)
            diff = diff2

    print(f"{ans[0]}/{ans[1]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
